content.value_statement: Enterprise Angular teams need consistent ng-alain components. This skill guides table, form, ACL, layout, theming, and accessibility patterns.
actual_capabilities: Creates ST table patterns with columns, badges, actions, pagination, and loading states.
Defines SF schema form examples with validation, async select data, submit, and change handling.
Shows PageHeader, breadcrumb, action button, modal, and drawer component patterns.
Applies @delon/acl examples for permission-gated buttons and programmatic checks.
Explains ng-zorro responsive grids, theme variables, dark mode, and accessibility checks.
limitations: It is guidance only and does not install dependencies or run Angular commands.
Examples use placeholder services and sample task data.
It assumes an Angular 20 project configured with ng-alain and ng-zorro-antd.
It does not include automated tests or migration scripts.

use_cases.title: Create Enterprise Tables
use_cases.description: Build task, user, or audit tables with ST columns, badges, actions, pagination, and loading states.

use_cases.title: Standardize Angular UI Patterns
use_cases.description: Align shared imports, @delon components, ACL checks, theming, and responsive layouts across product screens.

use_cases.title: Review Component Quality
use_cases.description: Check generated ng-alain components for accessibility labels, mobile layout behavior, and user feedback states.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Table
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a standalone ng-alain table component for [entity]. Use ST columns, loading state, pagination, and edit and delete actions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Schema Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an SF schema form for [entity]. Include required fields, async select options, submit handling, change handling, and responsive grid settings.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Managed Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete ng-alain page for [workflow]. Include PageHeader, breadcrumb, ST table, SF form in a modal or drawer, and ACL-gated actions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Existing Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Angular component for ng-alain best practices. Check shared imports, @delon usage, responsive layout, ACL coverage, theming, loading states, and accessibility.

output_examples.input: Create a task table with status badges and edit and delete actions.
output: A standalone Angular component using ng-alain ST table conventions.
Column guidance for identifiers, titles, status badges, dates, and row actions.
Notes for loading state, pagination, delete confirmation, and handler placement.

output_examples.input: Create a schema form for task creation with assignee and due date fields.
output: An SF form structure with title, description, status, priority, assignee, due date, and tags.
Validation guidance for required fields and field length limits.
Responsive grid guidance and event handling notes for submit and change events.

output_examples.input: Review my ng-alain dashboard for responsive layout and accessibility.
output: A review checklist covering grid breakpoints, component labels, loading states, and keyboard access.
Recommendations for theme variable usage and dark mode behavior.
Specific follow-up items for mobile testing and user feedback states.

best_practices: Use shared imports to keep ng-zorro and @delon dependencies consistent across standalone components.
Add loading, empty, error, and confirmation states for tables, forms, modals, and drawers.
Use responsive grid settings, theme variables, and ARIA labels for accessible enterprise screens.
anti_patterns: Do not bypass ACL checks by hiding protected actions only with CSS.
Do not hardcode desktop-only grid sizes for pages that need mobile support.
Do not leave table, form, modal, or drawer event handlers as unexplained placeholders.

faq.question: What Angular style does this skill use?
faq.answer: It follows Angular 20 standalone component patterns with signals and shared imports.

faq.question: Does this skill install ng-alain packages?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance and examples for projects that already have the libraries available.

faq.question: Can it help generate component code?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides an AI assistant to draft Angular component code that follows ng-alain and ng-zorro patterns.

faq.question: Does it cover access control?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes @delon/acl examples for permission-gated actions and code-level permission checks.

faq.question: Does it include accessibility guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes ARIA labels, proper form labels, responsive layout checks, and mobile testing guidance.

faq.question: Does it include backend API implementation?
faq.answer: No. Service calls and data sources are placeholders that must be connected to the project backend.
